audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Mel four stages and Skill three, with Sejuani never winning a stage, while the data has Sejuani at 54.35% over 92 games and both layers' prose calls the two-item stage 'your personal highlight reel'.
audit.why: Mel genuinely owns levels 1-5 as a ranged poke laner, so those stay. The back end is where the chart never caught up: content.late already says stacked resistances make Mel unable to stop any engage.
audit.corrected: win[5], win[6] and phases[5].side / phases[6].side now read Sejuani.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 2-3 spike said 'Mel's Q poke and W zone come fully online'. Mel's W is Rebuttal, a barrier — it is not a zone.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rebuttal 'forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed'. The zoning ability is Radiant Volley (Q); the lockdown is Solar Snare (E), a 1000-range root that the page never mentioned once.
audit.corrected: Spike now names Radiant Volley and Solar Snare.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] claimed Rebuttal reflects 'Glacial Prison or Arctic Assault'. wants.foe[1] called Rebuttal 'W's execute field'.
audit.why: Glacial Prison carries the projectile flag and Riot describes it as a thrown bola, so Rebuttal does reflect it — that part is right and it is the decisive interaction of the matchup. Arctic Assault has NO projectile flag; Riot's text is 'Sejuani charges forward', a charge, so it cannot be reflected. It still hits a Rebuttal that prevents her from taking damage, which is a different and worse problem. The execute is not on W at all — it is Searing Brilliance's Overwhelm stacks, amplified by Golden Eclipse, which strikes every Overwhelm-marked enemy 'regardless of their distance from her'.
audit.corrected: Reflection is now scoped to Glacial Prison only, the charge distinction is stated, and the execute is attributed to Overwhelm / Golden Eclipse.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid told the player to track Rebuttal's cooldown as 'roughly 20 seconds'.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26 seconds. Twenty is wrong at every rank, and it is wrong in the direction that gets the player killed — they will step up thinking the window has reopened when it has not, or more often waste eighteen seconds of a real window.
audit.corrected: mid now gives 38s at rank 1 falling to 26 at rank 5, and breakdown.cooldowns carries the same numbers plus Solar Snare's 9-11s and Radiant Volley's 6-10s.

edits.before: Mel's Q poke and W zone come fully online — she can deny CS and whittle your Permafrost passive off freely, so hug minions and wait for her to overstep.
edits.after: Radiant Volley (Q) and Solar Snare's 1000-range root come online — she denies CS and chips Frost Armor off, so hug minions and wait for her overstep.

edits.before: Zone Sejuani away from CS with W's execute field and R execute threat when she is low
edits.after: Zone Sejuani off CS with Radiant Volley and stack Overwhelm for the Golden Eclipse execute

edits.before: Reflect Glacial Prison or Arctic Assault back with Rebuttal to punish Sejuani's only engage tools
edits.after: Reflect Glacial Prison with Rebuttal (38s at rank 1) — Arctic Assault is a charge, not a projectile

edits.before: Neither champion has a kill threat: Mel has no burst yet and Sejuani's Permafrost chain requires Frost stacks she cannot build in one auto — farm safely and track Rebuttal's cooldown.
edits.after: Neither has a kill threat yet: Permafrost needs max Frost stacks one auto cannot build, and Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 — farm safely and count it from the moment it drops.

edits.before: Level 6 gives you Glacial Prison's long-range comet and suddenly Mel must respect standing anywhere close — the kill threat flips, though Rebuttal still makes it Skill.
edits.after: Glacial Prison's 1300-range bola makes Mel respect standing anywhere close — but it is a projectile, so Rebuttal (26-38s) reflects it and the stage stays a skill fight.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are Mel's strongest poke window — she builds AP and her Q's damage is meaningful now while your damage output hasn't spiked yet. Hug the wave, track Rebuttal's cooldown (roughly 20 seconds), and look for a jungle gank because your E stun is a guaranteed setup. Level 6 changes the threat calculus entirely: Glacial Prison is a long-range comet you can throw from outside her zone ability, and if it lands the blizzard stun gives your jungler or you an easy kill. Never throw Glacial Prison into a visible Rebuttal glow — she will reflect it back and you will stand in your own blizzard.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are Mel's strongest poke window — Radiant Volley chips you down while your own damage has not spiked yet. Hug the wave, track Rebuttal properly (38 seconds at rank 1, falling to 26 at rank 5), and look for a jungle gank because your Permafrost stun is a guaranteed setup. Level 6 changes the calculus entirely: Glacial Prison is a 1300-range bola you can throw from outside Radiant Volley, and if it lands the blizzard stun gives your jungler or you an easy kill. Never throw it into a lit Rebuttal — the bola is a projectile, it comes straight back, and you will stand stunned in your own blizzard.

edits.before: - Mel Rebuttal: matchup-defining — Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. Count it out loud if you must. - Your Q dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Mel Rebuttal (W): 38/35/33/29/26s — reflects projectiles AND prevents all damage, so Glacial Prison is off while it glows. - Solar Snare (E): 9-11s root at 1000 range. - Radiant Volley (Q): 6-10s. - Your Q is for when it goes wrong.

edits.before: Track Mel’s Rebuttal: Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Rebuttal reflects projectiles: Glacial Prison comes back at you, Arctic Assault does not — it is a charge.

edits.before: Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Rebuttal blocks all damage and reflects projectiles; it is 38s at rank 1, so poke only once it drops.

edits.before: Q is your only exit — spending it for damage leaves you stranded in jungle-gank range.
edits.after: Arctic Assault isn't reflected, but Rebuttal blocks its damage — you charge in for nothing.

notes: _missing-interactions flags 'Mel can cut your retreat with Rebuttal (W) and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall'. Both halves are wrong: Rebuttal is a barrier around HERSELF (the terrain flag is a misfire), and Sejuani does have a dash in Arctic Assault. Nothing from that headline was written. The other flagged rule, 'Mel's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Searing Brilliance)', is also a misfire — Riot's text says an ability grants bonus PROJECTILES on the next attack, not a reset — so I left it out too. The genuinely valuable Searing Brilliance fact, the Overwhelm execute paired with Golden Eclipse's unlimited range, did make it onto the page.
